post_court_findings.severity: defect in the court gate (determinism), never a spurious-pass for content changes
post_court_findings.finding: The court's tree_digest (find ... -exec shasum {} + | shasum) is order-nondeterministic: identical unchanged trees yield different digest values back-to-back. Witnessed: 4 distinct values for the unchanged cache tree across 4 computations (court POST c5eae69f..., receipt-time 1b89244f..., back-to-back bed28824... / 2337102c...); the SORTED per-file line-sets are identical in every case. Consequences: (a) unsorted digest values are not cross-run reproducible identity anchors; (b) the restore gate has a SPURIOUS-FAIL mode (a perfect restore can exit 3 on an ordering flip) — the content-fail direction is unaffected (any content delta changes the line multiset and flips the outer hash).
